messages.SUMMARY_ROTATION_FAILED: The rotation of the password of "{connection}" failed.
messages.SUMMARY_REQUEST_APPROVED: User "{actor}" approved the request of "{user}" for "{connection}", which needs more approvals.
messages.SUMMARY_REQUEST_GRANTED: User "{actor}" approved the request of "{user}" for "{connection}".
messages.SUMMARY_REQUEST_DENIED: User "{actor}" denied the request of "{user}" for "{connection}".
messages.SUMMARY_CHECKOUT_EXTENDED: The checkout of "{connection}" by "{user}" was extended.
messages.SUMMARY_CHECKOUT_REVOKED: The checkout of "{connection}" by "{user}" was ended.
messages.SUMMARY_CHECKOUT_REVOKED_BY: The checkout of "{connection}" by "{user}" was ended by "{actor}".
messages.SUMMARY_SERVER_STANDBY: Guacamole server "{server}" is on standby: PAM is read-only there.
messages.SUMMARY_SERVER_ACTIVE: PAM works again on Guacamole server "{server}".
messages.SUMMARY_TEST: A test from the PAM settings page, sent by "{actor}".
messages.DETAIL_GRANTED_RESERVED: The access is reserved for the time asked.
messages.ACTION_APPROVE: Approve or deny it on the Approvals tab
messages.ACTION_OPEN_DURING: Open the connection in Guacamole during that time
messages.ACTION_REQUEST_AGAIN: To use it again, request it again in Guacamole
messages.WHY_OWN: You receive this about your own requests and access. To stop, turn it off under Preferences > Email notifications in Guacamole.
messages.WHY_APPROVER: You receive this as an approver of the connection. To stop, turn it off under Preferences > Email notifications in Guacamole.
messages.WHY_ADMINISTRATOR: You receive this as a Guacamole administrator, for everything PAM does. To stop, turn it off under Preferences > Email notifications in Guacamole.
messages.WHY_ADDRESS: This address receives what Guacamole administrators receive, as set on the PAM Settings tab.
